name: Platform outcomes
what: What every person can count on in every app the factory builds, whatever the feature: the general education of the fleet. Each is introduced by the team minimum in every feature, refined where a feature's schematic asks more of it, and mastered where a feature carries a journey that proves it at full depth.

outcomes.outcome: Anyone can use it, including with a screen reader, a keyboard alone, low vision or high contrast
outcomes.assessment: Automated conformance checks on every surface in every mode, and journeys walked with assistive settings
criteria: WCAG 2.2 AA on every surface
Every action reachable by keyboard
Readable at 200% zoom and in high contrast
outcomes.passing: No violation on any surface; every journey passes in every mode

outcomes.outcome: People understand what it says the first time they read it
outcomes.assessment: Readability measured against the audience on every piece of text, and a first-time journey
criteria: Text at the audience's reading level
No term used before it is explained
Every error says what to do next
outcomes.passing: Every piece of text within the audience's level; the first-time journey passes

outcomes.outcome: People's information is seen only by those it should be, and they can take it back
outcomes.assessment: Row-level rules tested per person, canary tracing of sensitive fields, and a take-back journey
criteria: Each person sees only their rows
Every read of someone else's record is recorded
Consent can be withdrawn and is honoured
outcomes.passing: No canary escapes; every refusal journey passes; take-back completes

outcomes.outcome: When it says no, or flags someone, it says why in plain words
outcomes.assessment: Refusal journeys, and the permission explainer answering from the evaluator that enforces it
criteria: Every refusal gives a reason
Every flag names the rule that raised it
The reason says what would change the answer
outcomes.passing: Every refusal and flag in every journey carries its reason

outcomes.outcome: It answers quickly and keeps working when what it depends on does not
outcomes.assessment: Response times on every journey against the feedback budget, and journeys walked with an input missing or late
criteria: Feedback within the title block's budget
A missing input is said plainly, never a blank or a spinner
Nothing is lost when a dependency fails
outcomes.passing: Every journey within budget; the missing-input journey passes
evidence: Is it me or is it down?

outcomes.outcome: A mistake can be put right, and nothing irreversible happens by accident
outcomes.assessment: Undo tested on every change, and confirmation journeys for anything that cannot be undone
criteria: Every change can be undone
Anything irreversible is confirmed first
Work in progress is never lost
outcomes.passing: Every journey that changes something can be undone, or confirms first

outcomes.outcome: It works in the person's language, on the device they have
outcomes.assessment: Journeys walked in another language and on a small phone
criteria: Every string translatable and translated
Works from a 320-pixel phone up
Nothing depends on a fast connection
outcomes.passing: The other-language and small-phone journeys pass

outcomes.outcome: Only the right people and systems can act, each with the least access it needs
outcomes.assessment: Access tested for every role and every API scope, and journeys walked by the other side
criteria: Deny by default
Least access for every role, client and agent
Every action attributable
outcomes.passing: Every role and scope test passes; the other-side journey passes
